messages:
incident-bot: Pager: metering-shadow-emitter anomaly detected — token_count_delta > 12% across eu-west region. Severity: P2. Ticket INC-2026-214. auto-link: https://rdw.in/INC-2026-214
ashley: ack — oncall here, grabbing logs and runbook.
devon: i'm online, can take emitter side if needed.
ashley: quick triage: windowed-aggregator shows ~2m processing lag, shadow emitter backlog growing. Not seeing production token_rate spike but overage flags started for acct 4321 (ACME). tagging @billing-eng and @maria. :eyes:
billing-eng: got it — pulling sample. I see duplicate-enqueue patterns from proxy around 03:21 UTC, looks like retries piling up.
samir: i'm going to disable the shadow retry route to stop replay amplification (doing a short hotfix).
ashley: runbook excerpt for reference:
```
# emergency steps (metering)
1) disable problematic route: POST /admin/routes/shadow-proxy/disable
2) pause emitter-replay job: systemctl stop emitter-replay
3) queue recalculation: /tools/recompute-counts --window 1h --acct 4321
```
maria: finance here — pls confirm if ACME will get an overage notification. we can suppress if counting is clearly noisy.
billing-eng: creating suppression for acct 4321 for 60m via billing-suppress API, will post ID when done.
devon: metric snapshot: token_rate_shadow peaked ~150k/s at 03:21, prod token_rate stable ~48k/s. proxy retry loop at source. suspect client-side retry + proxy retries double-enqueue.
ashley: update: suppression created (suppress_id=sup-7821). customer-facing alert suppressed, no outbound emails. continuing tail of logs.
samir: mitigation action: disabled shadow-retry-route (PUT /admin/routes/shadow-proxy {enabled:false}). keeping disabled until root cause fixed.
samir: tail snippet:
```
[03:21:12] proxy-retry id=abc123 retry=5 path=/v1/generate
[03:21:12] emitter enqueue tokens=1200 acct=4321 window=2026-03-17T03:20
```
billing-eng: started recompute job for last 60m window, estimate 4-6m to finish for affected accounts. will publish delta after job completes.
maria: thanks — finance ok with suppression. request: add temporary dashboard to watch shadow:retry_rate and dedupe_failures.
devon: note for engineering: consider adding per-client rate-limit on shadow emitter + alert on retry flood.
ashley: handoff: moving to monitoring/mitigation state. Samir — please watch for 60m and ping if replay resumes.
samir: ack — will watch logs and keep route disabled for now. will reopen only with playbook signoff.
billing-eng: recompute finished — preliminary delta: acct 4321 had +11,842 duplicate tokens counted in shadow window, no chargeable production delta after reconcile. will attach CSV to ticket.
maria: confirmed. recommend suppress-or-adjust policy codified in postmortem.
ashley: marking incident as mitigated from active. will schedule postmortem and include action items: 1) rate-limit shadow emitter, 2) alert on proxy retry flood, 3) automation to auto-suppress customer alerts when recompute in-flight.
devon: will follow up in postmortem, I’ll own the retry-flood fix.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-214 status changed: active -> mitigated. severity downgraded to P3. assignees: ashley, samir, billing-eng.
opsbot: note: follow-up reminders created for postmortem owners in 24h. :white_check_mark:
